Buttons with Icons

Heroicons inlined as SVG. inline-flex items-center gap-2 overrides the panel's inline-block. Padding is reduced on the icon side (pl-3 for leading, pr-3 for trailing) for optical balance — icon glyphs carry built-in whitespace that makes equal padding read as asymmetric.
